# Coupled pilot

Run the pilot using `scripts/run_coupled_pilot.py`.

## Case selection

By default, all cases in the suite are run in their original order. To select specific cases, use one or more `--case` flags:

```
python scripts/run_coupled_pilot.py --case alpha --case gamma
```

- Each named case will be run once, in the order it appears in the suite, regardless of the order or repetition of `--case` flags.
- Duplicate `--case` flags for the same ID are ignored after the first occurrence.
- If any unknown case ID is given, the script will fail before creating output or executing any case.
- If no `--case` flags are provided, all cases are run (no filtering).
- The no-overwrite guard prevents existing receipts from being overwritten.
- Each case runs with its own independent oracle.

# Coupled pilot

Run the pilot using `scripts/run_coupled_pilot.py`.

## Case Selection

By default (without `--case`), all cases in the suite run in their original order.

Use `--case` to select specific cases. Repeat the flag to select multiple cases; each named case runs once in the original suite order, and duplicate selections are ignored.

Example:
```bash
python scripts/run_coupled_pilot.py \
  --binary ./target/debug/my-binary \
  --repo ./my-repo \
  --out ./results \
  --provider openai \
  --model gpt-4 \
  --case alpha \
  --case gamma
```

This runs only the `alpha` and `gamma` cases, in the order they appear in the suite, each exactly once.

If any `--case` value does not match a known case ID, the script fails immediately before creating any output or executing any case.
